endorsements.name: 10:00 Breaking Wireless Encryption Keys
endorsements.label: DC 101 Thursday Talks
endorsements.description: Cracking Wireless encryption keys is a fundamental capability that should be in every penetration tester's skill set. This talk will walk you through the basic steps necessary to break Wireless Encryption Protocol (WEP) and steps to perform dictionary and brute force attacks against Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA & WPA2).
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
